info.title: RuangPijar BFF API
info.description: Backend-for-frontend REST API for RuangPijar, backed by MongoDB/Mongoose and Next.js Route Handlers. Every endpoint below (except `/api/auth/*`) requires the Auth.js session cookie set by signing in through `/api/auth/signin` (Google) or a `POST` to `/api/auth/callback/credentials` (email + password). Auth.js also exposes `/api/auth/signout`, `/api/auth/csrf`, and `/api/auth/providers`, which are not re-documented here since their shape is defined by the library, not this app.

get.description: Merges check-ins, action logs, and insights into one chronological feed, newest first. There's no dedicated Jejak model — entries are assembled on read from the other three collections.

post.description: Rule-based analysis (no ML/LLM) over the last 14 days of check-ins: mood/stress/energy trend shifts, a stress↔sleep Pearson correlation, and a dominant stressor-factor pattern. Returns an empty array with a 200 if there are fewer than 3 check-ins in the window or no candidate crosses its threshold.
